key_findings: Spinal Hv1 is upregulated after spinal nerve transection and Hv1 KO mice show attenuated late-phase pain hypersensitivity.
Microglial Hv1 drives ROS production, astrocyte activation and astrocytic IFN-gamma upregulation, forming a microglia-astrocyte axis in pain maintenance.
